CHAPTER.VERS: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil; for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
Behold, children are a heritage of Jehovah. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
Blessed is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won't be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
